notes.title: "Desert Reign" Coming Q4 with Character Creator!
notes.content:
[p]Hello Defiers!

Last Friday, August 15th was our 1 year anniversary in Early Access! We wanted to thank all of our players for joining us so far in early access and lending your valuable feedback throughout this open-development process! We're really excited to continue working on Dawn of Defiance to make it the best Greek-myth survival craft game on the market!
[/p][previewyoutube="cR8BPImteaw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Reflect back on our time in Early Access together with the recap video above! But if you're only here to find out what's next...[/p][h2]
DESERT REIGN
[/h2][p]Our next major update is already well underway and coming to players before the end of 2025! Dawn of Defiance "Desert Reign" will bring a new raid to the Temple of Poseidon in the Ancient Desert with more puzzles, more gear, and more enemies! It will also bring additional skill levels and the first iteration of character creator, including the female player model! That's right, you will be able to play a woman on the Crossroads THIS YEAR! [/p][previewyoutube="1bCi8d-7gjY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
You'll see "Desert Reign" now reflected on an updated Roadmap graphic which has moved a couple features to a separate category. As we intend to expand on the raids, enemies, and gear with every major update, you'll see those remaining in the "updating soon" category as a "regular" feature. Features specific to the next major update will move to "in-progress," as you'll now see for "character creator."  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/0c5688e126066fa9bdac4cc7808acf4f323bb1ac.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This information was first revealed and discussed on [url="https://www.twitch.tv/traegagames"]our Twitch[/url], including a conversation with Game Director Tony. The VOD is temporarily saved on Twitch, and it will be archived on our [url="https://www.youtube.com/@TraegaGames"]YouTube channel[/url]. If you wish to join our livestreams for future announcements and behind-the-scenes developments, make sure to follow us! 

Please get excited to hear more about these specific features and a closer look at behind-the-scenes progress next month![/p][h2]
Giveaway[/h2][p]
As for our anniversary! We wanted to celebrate by hosting a Giveaway for 5 Dawn of Defiance keys! If you want a key for yourself or a friend ahead of "Desert Reign," here's how you can participate:

[b][i]Before August 27th[/i][/b]
1. Follow us at [url="https://x.com/traegagames"]https://x.com/traegagames[/url]
2. Retweet our "Desert Reign" [url="https://x.com/TraegaGames/status/1958228112954871954"]Twitter post here.[/url]

I will select 5 winners on [b][i]August 27th[/i][/b] from those that do both of the above, and I will DM you on Twitter with your key, so keep your eye out after that time. We still have less than 1,000 followers on Twitter, so even if you don't wish to participate in the Giveaway, we hope to see you there!

Thank you all again for your incredible support. Stay tuned for more on Desert Reign![/p]

notes.title: 0.2.1.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
[p]Happy Tuesday!

Today we have an update with a couple important hotfixes, addressing the frozen/stuck refineries players were experiencing following our last minor update, plus a raid-related crash.[/p][p]After today’s hotfix you’ll also see a pretty obvious change to the world map! This overlay that extends past the existing biome has been added as a warning indicator of incoming geography changes with our next major update. [b]Any part of the landscape within the highlighted region may be altered as soon as the next update, so we advise you to not build here OR to remove your existing builds from within this region![/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/498f208df8de4c9521674f99509e6b2e1fa0d035.png"][/img][/p][p]This overlay is NOT an indicator that you are currently unable to enter or play in the desert. Please continue slaying skeletons to your heart’s content.[/p][p]As stated in our minor update last week, more details surrounding the next major update will be provided with a couple status changes on the roadmap next month. Thank you for your patience. Until then![/p][p] [/p][h2][b]0.2.1.1 Hotfix Changelist[/b][/h2][h3]

notes.title: 0.2.0.0 Major Update "Sisters of the Deep" Now Live!
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]SISTERS OF THE DEEP[/b][/u][/h2][p][/p][p]Our first major update is here! As you begin a new journey in the afterlife, seeking Elysium through the Crossroads, you discover the gates of the Underworld are sealed! The answer may be hidden within Athena’s Temple, but be warned, Spartan! In the Gods' mysterious absence, her shrine has been overrun by her enemies…[/p][p]“Sisters of the Deep” asks you to [b][i]start from a new save[/i][/b] to enjoy improvements from very early gameplay objectives to the new end of our current early access content. For a look at the major feature additions, please enjoy this content trailer:
[/p][previewyoutube="txRRE-pcW8c;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][u][b]HIGHLIGHTS[/b][/u][/h2][p][/p][p]Our first major update begins to address our own, original early access goals, but also to address the feedback we received from our players! You’ll find new enemies that draw from the Greek myths, new weapons inspired by the Gods, ease on new players, yet more depth of challenge and reward as players progress, and more! [/p][p][/p][h3]More Dangerous[/h3][p]”Sisters of the Deep” brings our first raid experience against the game’s first major bosses, the Gorgon Sisters. Take on each sister in a multi-stage fight in the instanced Temple of Athena! And even beyond the Temple and the Dark Forest, you’ll find the new Satyr enemy type and more fauna to defeat on the Crossroads.[/p][p][/p][h3]More Powerful[/h3][p]With greater challenge, comes greater reward! Overcoming the dangers of Athena’s Temple will earn you new powerful relics, from unique items once carried by creatures of myth, to a new inlay system to empower your gear. These items come alongside a new armor set to the Armory, plus a brand new facility, the Hephaestus Forge where you weld together the Gods' very own weapons.[/p][p][/p][h3]More Engaging[/h3][p]In our quest to make better quests, we’re overhauling the major shrine objectives on the Crossroads  and this update starts with revisions to the first four shrines: Apollo, Hephaestus, and Ares, adding puzzles and new challenges across the Dark Forest, each which drive you closer to the raid on Athena’s Temple! Plus! The first iteration of fishing! Rejoice! No more wolf hearts tonight.[/p][p][/p][h3]and More Intuitive![/h3][p]Besides the adjustments to early tutorial objectives, which includes movement ability based challenges to the Places of Power, new Defiers should find their way on the Crossroads with more guidance, now in the form of new experience pop-ups and the new player Compendium! With the Compendium, you can compile and access information you discover on your odyssey![/p][p] [/p][p]And this update is only the beginning! These changes offer fun, new content and lay significant groundwork for our future updates, but there’s much we still intend to add and improve upon, from both the original release content and new content we’ve added with Sisters of the Deep. We’re excited to continue expanding, and community feedback has been a huge part of this process. Thanks for helping us make this happen, and we hope you all are excited to continue this journey on our 1.0 Roadmap! [/p][p]As with release, please track and report your bugs or feedback on [url="https://dawnofdefiance.featureupvote.com/"]Feature Up-vote[/url]! This is the most reliable way for our team to assess community alignment on content and mechanics, so please use it! We also regularly compile the bug reports from there. You can also go to our[url="https://discord.gg/dV6s7CHHZj"] Discord[/url] to ask for support, discuss content, or band together with other defiant Spartans! 

[i]Reminder! This update is likely to cause significant issues with old saves. The main menu should prevent you from accessing old saves, but if you attempt to bypass this method and launch an old world, you are likely to experience a variety of gameplay issues, if not frequent crashes. [/i]

notes.title: May Devblog | Sneak Peak at Bosses, Weapons, & Map Changes
notes.content:
Hello, Defiers!

We hope you’re looking forward to Dawn of Defiance's "Sisters of the Deep," our first major update coming next month! If you’re anxious to know more about what’s coming in June, beyond what we’ve discussed in our [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLzgU15_TGMuwpUUvHTrriwIQwf_gAvpC1]DevTalks[/url] and [url=https://youtu.be/thApCK09KCw]April news video,[/url] we’re here to bring you another short glimpse at our progress. Minor content spoilers ahead. We’ll keep it brief, as we don’t want to give too much away (and we’re also really busy).  Let’s start with discussing map changes!

[h2]Story and Map Changes[/h2]

You’ll notice a couple name changes on the map art. With this update making some sweeping narrative revisions, including new copy for most objectives that will reframe the storyline and the player’s role on Aegea, we’re changing the “Isle of Arrival” to the more immersive, “Veilpoint.” Alongside this, Aeacus will be stepping aside for a new quest giver, but don’t worry, you’ll still be defying the Gods. That’s priority #1. You’ll also see the Dark Forest has expanded! The biome has grown to accommodate the new shrine experience and the challenges to unlock the Temple of Athena! Not shown on the updated map art are the new points of interest within the Dark Forest. You’ll have to discover those yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/59efed987cb5139c0fcf90531216e5c85bdd64bd.gif[/img]

[i][b]Disclaimer:[/b] The significant changes coming to quest objectives, from the tutorial to the raid, will cause conflicts with existing saves, as it will alter all of your character data. Which means, unfortunately, it is unlikely you will be able to launch and revisit old builds. This is something we hope to avoid in the future, but for this update, in order to rework these initial quests, this was our only option with our team’s time and bandwidth. Of course, we think these changes are worth your restart and contribute to the overall benefit of the game in early access![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/045082062228641164408cea32d9646687ee2e8c.gif[/img]

[h2]Weapon Highlight[/h2]

On our roadmap, we promised "Sisters of the Deep" would come with more awesome weapons, and we’re excited to put three new legendary items and three new unique items in your hands (plus new armor)! Now what’s the difference between the two types? Unique gear will be added to your options at the Armorer, but legendary gear will be crafted separately and each bring special combat abilities. To give you a better idea, may I present to you: Athena’s Solarium.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/993c86f17d78b4d9200a97da7b5876bd7aa1eb87.gif[/img]

The Solarium is a legendary shield, sister to the Athena’s Aegis. The Solarium allows Athena to weaken foes by simply raising her shield. When raised, any gorgon magic is completely nullified. The Solarium’s primary ability is Solarwind: After 5 successful blocks, the next block creates a burst of golden light, inflicting Parry on all enemies in a 8M Radius. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/9e9b4dbec727d9c781b013accef74e75a6213d0e.gif[/img]

You’ll only be able to craft the Solarium and the other impressive weapons coming to Sisters of the Deep after you’ve completed the Temple of Athena raid and proven you’re worthy of carrying such divine relics.

[h2]New Lesser Fauna[/h2]

Have we mentioned that Aegea will now be home to even more fauna!? Of the lesser variety, the Defier’s first foe will be the terrible, dangerous Rooster. You’ll find them across the Mediterranean, alongside their chicken counterparts. They are definitively aggressive, but I beg any Defier who dies at the hands of a Rooster to please alert the entire community immediately, so we can laugh at you. Together. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/e698754d0886aa6c60f63e6dd3b09eeba8ab2460.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/0648658e84b2e7e514fd5c6cab21d0949825407a.gif[/img]

[h2]Boss Sneak Peak[/h2]

Lastly, as you know, the highlight of our update will be the major boss fights. This is the best glimpse I can give you of what you’ll be up against! We continue to withhold the full reveals of these intimidating Sisters, but I’ve heard tales of their powerful gaze, so perhaps that is for the best. The boss fights will include mini puzzles and multiple rounds of combat. Each sister possesses special abilities and mechanics you must adapt to and overcome in order to progress through the raid. And just to confirm to everyone, single-players will be able to take on the raids by themselves! The difficulty will adjust for up to four players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/651c5385d8ec415117eb1ca1642827a03312f8e3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/8f59801f0843e12813151042aad07a4face739c7.gif[/img]

We’re not far from the update now! We’re working on the new content trailer while playtesting, and it is unlikely I will have another sneak preview before then! Thank you so much for supporting Dawn of Defiance so far. Please remember to take a picture of your current builds and share them with us in [url=https://discord.gg/dV6s7CHHZj]Discord[/url] (for posterity)! And we’ll see you all in June!

notes.title: 0.1.7.1 Combat Improvements Patch + Hotfix - 2/7/2025
notes.content:
Hello Defiers!

Our minor patch this month brings you improvements to our current combat experience with new sword animations, better targeting, changes to ranges and timings, and various tweaks to smooth out multiplayer combat.  These changes are to better align us with the major update coming in early Q2, so expect more improvements to combat in the future.

Here are the changes you will see today:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/eb509ef0d7c5fbf67421c6233e67609256c4b1cb.jpg[/img]

[b]Published (2/7/25 @ 11:20am CT)[/b]
[h2]0.1.7.0 PATCH[/h2]
-
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[olist][*] Backend adjustments and bugfixes to smooth out player combat in a multiplayer setting, such as addressing client-based desyncs.
[*] Reworked how enemy targeting works for melee combat
[*] Added a chevron above your current target to denote who you are actively targeting
[*] Enemy health bars have also been adjusted to be more responsive and remain visible if you hold that enemy as a target
[*] New sword attack animations
[*] Player combat animations, timings, and ranges for gap closing have been adjusted
[*] Removed the "Gorgon’s Gaze" debuff. Debuff to be revisited when more combat improvements have been made.
[*] Replaced the Soldier’s "Slow" debuff with "Weak."
[*] Camera shake has been adjusted for certain scenarios, including the Skeleton spawn event[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/62c20c62705f1ccc2a632928b71b7ece5964fd42.png[/img]

[h3]BUG FIXES:[/h3]
[olist][*] Fixed an issue where combo attacks could occasionally fail after a Sprint attack
[*] Fixed an issue where certain attacks were still blocking Block and Dodge actions
[*] Fixed an issue with knockback direction when hit with certain AOE attacks
[*] Fixed an issue with Abandoned firing off multiple attacks at once
[*] Fixed an issue with Gorgons entering a passive state when interrupted during combat
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the Golem’s boulder to explode prematurely
[*] Fixed an issue where clients would experience screen shake if Skeleton spawns were triggered by other players
[*] Fixed an issue with Stone Roofs displaying flickering textures when constructing[/olist]
Please continue to report your bugs to our [url=https://dawnofdefiance.featureupvote.com/]Feature Up-Vote![/url] If you have questions about this patch, please visit our [url=https://discord.gg/dV6s7CHHZj]Discord[/url] or Steam Discussions. You can email support@traega.com at any time.


[b]UPDATE (2/7/25 @ 2:30pm CT)[/b]
[h2]0.1.7.1 HOTFIX[/h2]

We have submitted a follow-up hotfix to correct a broken "Harvester" quest that had snuck into the patch. If you created a new world since the patch this morning and discovered the broken Harvester quest, you will need to recreate the world after downloading the hotfix.
---

Besides hotfixes, our next update may be our first major content update "Sisters of the Deep!" We'll tease more about this throughout the next couple months. Get excited!

Thank you!

notes.title: Roadmap Revealed! "Sisters of the Deep" Major Update Coming Early Q2 2025!
notes.content:
Today, we were thrilled to be featured at the OTK Winter Games Expo to share some exciting news! Our first major content update "Sisters of the Deep" is coming your way in early Q2 2025. It marks the first of our planned updates on our Early Access roadmap to our 1.0 Release. Please check out this video we premiered at the event with current gameplay and a short teaser for the upcoming update:

[previewyoutube=M0fzDkRgmlA;full][/previewyoutube]
"Sisters of the Deep" will be bringing massive improvements to the Dark Forest, notably an overhaul of four shrines, culminating with boss fights and new legendary weapons and armor.

Athena has been watching your defiance on the Crossroads closely, and its time to face the consequences. Soon, she awakens the Gorgon Sisters within her shrine for a challenge like nothing you've yet faced in Dawn of Defiance. We're super excited to bring you this update, and we believe it will be a great start to addressing the features we've outlined for Early Access.

[h2]Our Living Roadmap![/h2]

Our living roadmap, which we've been revising behind the scenes using your player feedback, is now available! To see at full size, click [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1fNHap8fmVAm3cSk5wpqYzIGmZNZVw5du/view?usp=sharing]here.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/33a77751b25c6aba84f71144464966c1d69b2d2e.jpg[/img]
It lists 33 features we plan to implement before 1.0, along with the current status of those features in development. As you can see, Sisters of the Deep will be the first of five currently planned updates, each focused around biomes on the Crossroads. We are currently expecting to release updates in 3-4 month intervals, but we will officially set the expected dates for each update as we move along. 

To walk you through this announcement and the introduction of our roadmap, please check out this video from our Game Director Tony:

[previewyoutube=WdwGN_uE5Ew;full][/previewyoutube]
We hope these resources help set expectations for new and current players alike for our intentions in Early Access and provide transparency into our development as we go along. We will be updating this roadmap with new statuses as we make significant progress or release updates. We will be following up this information with more detail on "Sisters of the Deep" in coming months as we get closer to shipping.

You can always refer back to our website to easily find this graphic and feature status.
Visit: [url=www.dawnofdefiance.com/roadmap]DoD Roadmap[/url]

If you'd like to see what we've worked on so far, check out our Steam News hub or our [url=https://www.dawnofdefiance.com/news]News[/url] page on the website.

Thank you, Defiers!
- Traega Team

notes.title: 0.1.5.0 Combat and AI Patch - 11/22/2024
notes.content:
We're excited to bring some more improvements to your Dawn of Defiance playthrough! If you haven't followed our past two blogs teeing up this new patch, get ready for a variety of combat and AI-related improvements, in addition to more quality-of-life changes and bug fixes. But WAIT, there's more! This patch also welcomes in our new skeleton enemy, new mace weapons, enemy camps, roaming patrols, and the very exciting first iteration of our Town Center buildable!

As the changes for this patch largely touch on mid-game improvements and progression, they're likely best enjoyed from a fresh playthrough, but you don't have to restart unless you prefer, of course! Your saves should not break. If they do, please contact us immediately by Discord or support@traega.com!


Reminder that on December 4th, we'll be getting you a revised roadmap and more information about our first new content-focused update! Now, take a read through the following patch notes, and we'll see you on the Crossroads! If you have new feedback or bugs to report, please use our [url=https://dawnofdefiance.featureupvote.com/]feature up-vote[/url], our [url=https://discord.gg/dV6s7CHHZj]Discord[/url], or visit Steam Discussions!

notes.title: Patch This Friday! And more November News!
notes.content:
[h2]Next Patch: Now November 22![/h2]

Hello Defiers! We hope you’ve been having a beautiful autumn November! In our last article, we told you our next patch would be coming November 27, but we’re officially ahead of schedule! The next patch, focused on combat and AI improvements, will instead be coming November 22nd (this Friday, pog)! This allows you all to play the updates more during your Thanksgiving break AND allows us more time to work with players to clean-up any surprise bugs before the holidays.

[h2]We're coming to the OTK Winter Expo![/h2]
Plus! We can happily share we will be featured at the OTK Winter Expo this December 4th! We have been saving news about our roadmap as part of our participation in this event, so you’ll see more information about that go live at the same time. It should be a fun day for us, and we hope you tune in! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/abfe8b185279a2d078ef8a2b33f6ea6b54d0f893.jpg[/img]

As for now, here’s some MORE behind the scenes previews of the changes you’ll see this weekend when you return to the Crossroads!

Game Art:
[h3]ORE POLISH[/h3]
The Crossroads are richer than ever! The next patch will populate the islands with more resources nodes, and many ore assets have been polished after an art and audio pass. With these changes, the resources will be easier to identify and distinguish from each other. Check out these visuals of the new Copper ore mesh and texture from our environment artist. It will definitely be time to update the fandom wiki map on the 22nd!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/9670400396360566f0c8cd1b600f91791360bd70.png[/img]

Animation:
[h3]DOWNWARD STRIKE[/h3]
Last update, we showed you some work-in-progress polish on glide movements! We’ve also recently implemented an update to Hardfall. Using your weapon while gliding has always triggered Hardfall, but now the animation includes an appropriate weapon attack, so the move has been renamed to “Downward Strike!” A sword coming down at you at a 100mph? I wouldn’t want to be a Gorgon, personally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/d60a5aa24b1b5d4fe05c555dcd12ae7460e5554b.gif[/img]

Design:
[h3]NEW LOOTABLES[/h3]
Wouldn’t you believe it, the Gods' followers are eating like kings! Come end of this week, enemies may drop strong consumables, coming in two varieties: Spiced and Infused. They sprinkled God-dust on them, or something like that. For the time being, you will be unable to craft these specialty foods, but you’ll definitely want to keep them in handy for those tougher fights as they’ll boost your stats up to twice as much as your regular cooked foods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/5b6eceada1e1b3897376767408937510cf045964.gif[/img]

AI Updates:
[h3]BOAR CHARGE[/h3]
There’s an assortment of AI improvements currently being tested for the upcoming patch across all existing enemies. A highlight amongst them that I’ve enjoyed is the new boar charge which makes them a much more troublesome and engaging enemy to combat with! Catch me trying to get a boar to headbutt me clear off a cliff. I’ll return with confirmation soon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/c72b081f82f6b193c04ae67327c8cb7b0a423d0a.gif[/img]

[Bug Fix:
[h3]STAMINA REGEN[/h3]
Players (including myself) had been running into a strange bug where gliding into the water would lock your stamina, making it unable to regenerate. We’ll say your figurative wings were getting wet. Forever. But the QA boys were able to isolate the instance, and it will be on the list of fixes for the coming patch. You may return to your river-diving festivities immediately.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/fd3538cb05c39c23bef7f9544012c892ac355ed5.gif[/img]

Bonus:
[h3]DESERT AMBLERS?[/h3]
Did you enjoy the cackles last month? Here’s another sneak peak of the new enemy ambling in the desert. Have you guessed what it is yet? This gif is really mysterious, right? You can’t tell what it is at all :) Warning in advance of Friday…you may be jump-scared by these guys. There have been incidents… We’re excited for you guys to experience it yourself soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/a099cea8b001be0691c5d96b408a6358a77dbadc.gif[/img]

Lastly, thank you to everyone who responded to our poll last month. Between Steam and Discord, more foundational pieces and new functional buildables were nearly tied for first with 19% & 18% of voters, and new storage & shelving a close third at 16%! ﻿We'll be keeping that information in mind as we work on more buildables.

That’s all for today! We’ll be back Friday with the full patch notes and greater details on specific features! Until then, cheers and long live the Defiance!

notes.title: When's the Next Patch? October News!
notes.content:
Hello Defiers!

As we reach the end of October, we wanted to pass along news of the next patch, as well as an update for those anticipating a revised & accessible roadmap for early access!

[h3]Our next patch will be coming [b][u]November 27th![/u][/b] Expect this update to focus on improving AI and combat. Shortly after, on [b][u]December 4th[/u][/b], we’ll provide you the new living roadmap, alongside greater detail about the NEXT update which will be the first to feature new content & objectives![/h3]

We will be releasing updates at a wider cadence going forward for the sake of efficiency. For a little additional context on these dates, check out my super professional video here:

[previewyoutube=Lquf_U-VqjA;full][/previewyoutube]

I sent this video to the directors for review, and their response was, and I quote: "What is an acceptable level of cringe. Scientifically." Let us know if you have shriveled into a raisin while watching this video. Fax them your opinions.

Thanks for playing with us and continuing to support us in our early access development. The best is yet to come! As for me, I’ll continue improving how we share updates on the game’s development to you all! For now, here’s some bits of work happening in the background:

[h2]BTS Developments[/h2]

Early this month, our animator had gone back to improve glide, particularly the weaponed stance. The main detail he adjusted was the wrist and head, lowering the position so they align better with the movement animations. He says while the work isn’t challenging, it is time consuming because he has to make manual adjustments for all the weapons, including all flight directions and speeds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/287c66c4f5c7a74411ac29f380749c15974961ba.jpg[/img]

Our environmental artist is working on new foliage! Tree types are first created with specific branch, trunk, and leaf proportions. Once a tree type’s visual style is established, different size variations are created using the same rules applied to the parent tree. An asset that can be chopped down is complex compared to a flower that can simply be picked. A tree requires around 20 assets working together in game to accomplish our chopping mechanic. The colored clusters shown here visualize groupings and hierarchies in the tree that are used for wind animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/36ef9f1a61ceefec3c7424f07255487098883da1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/2cd4419df966b362f475a76dac0671bdd7e23a53.jpg[/img]

Our stone doorways recently got doors attached, thank goodness, but did you notice the detail of the different sounds for the different door types. If you didn’t, its probably because our audio director’s really good at his job.  As you guys know, he records all the sound effects himself! He sent me a whole bunch of clips of his original audio capture, testing to find the right sounds for the doors.

[previewyoutube=rX3dNCscABg;full][/previewyoutube]

As mentioned in the video, some enemies may now be roaming the map, so you’ll have to be extra vigilant. The soldiers on the Isle of Arrival, in particular, are extra scary when you’re still starting off and crafting decent gear. Here’s a small glimpse at your future playthrough:
 
[previewyoutube=MmKO-YopM6g;full][/previewyoutube]

As a treat for spooky season, here’s a new recording for a fun addition coming to our November patch. I will be providing no further context. What do you think it is?

[previewyoutube=PHMk4fLtmt4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]BUILDABLES POLL[/h2]

While that’s the last of the behind the scenes previews for now, we do have one thing to ask of you! If you’re a fan of building in Dawn of Defiance and anxiously awaiting more build pieces and decor, please swing by this poll we’ve started that compiles the various buildable-related requests we’ve seen! We ask that you vote on the types of buildables you’d most like to see (or see first).

[i]PLEASE NOTE: The conclusion of this poll does not guarantee these buildables will be included in the next couple updates, but it will help our art team get a sense of which items players are most excited about. Plus, just because we're polling players on buildables, that does not mean buildables & decor are our highest priority at the minute. This is one of many things being worked on![/i]

You can vote in [url=https://discord.gg/dV6s7CHHZj]Discord[/url] here. Disclaimer, the following poll link only works if you're an existing Discord member with Defier permissions: [url=https://discord.com/channels/1159972397714243696/1235406596528537671/1300562029463207986]Discord Poll.[/url]

If you don't like Discord, you can also vote in the Steam Discussions post here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2059530/discussions/0/4702413966613204902/]Discussions Poll.[/url]

________________

That’s all for today’s news, but I’ll see you again later this week with our Temple Tracker “Haunted Crossing” build submissions and clips of the Playtrials: Tides of Triumph relay race! If we don’t catch you then, have a wonderful rest of your month and get excited for the update in November!

Best,
Traega Monday & Team

notes.title: September Quality of Life Patch - 9/26/2024
notes.content:
Happy September! We hope you're excited for another quality-of-life patch today, featuring some often-requested improvements such as map markers, artisan and armorer previews, continue buttons, and more, alongside a SLEW of bug fixes. Check out this patch highlight video and read the following notes for more detail!

[previewyoutube=rSArWkfvvYE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]FEATURE ADDITIONS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Map - Several additions and improvements have been made to the map.[list]
[*] The player can now mark the map with a waypoint which will appear on the compass to guide them toward a destination without reopening the map.
[*] The map now has a custom markers widget which allows players to stamp their map with several icons in different colors.
[*] The map now displays information about a particular marker when hovering the cursor over it. 
[*] Zooming out will now cover the entire map regardless of resolution
[*] Some temp map markers like player markers have been updated.[/list][*] Stone Doors have been added to the buildable kit.
[*] Armory and Artisan now display a preview of the item being crafted/customized.
[*] Artisan bench now supports helmet plumes.
[*] Main Menu now has a continue button to quickly join the last known world. 
[*] Added an official Creative mode ruleset. (Experimental)
[/list]
[h2]IMPROVEMENTS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Density of fauna has been greatly increased in the Mediterranean biome.
[*] Wolves now roam the Dark Forest instead of Deer.
[*] Captains now protect shrines instead of Gorgons.
[*] Large changes to trees and mining node health to match the required mining tool damage. 
[*] Durability has been balanced on all items. 
[*] Golem has undergone a plethora of combat changes.
[*] Soldiers now teleport to starting location when reaching the end of their leash.
[*] Melee targeting in combat has been improved
[*] Updated player character animations. 
[*] Players can now punch with just a shield in hand.
[*] Player can now dodge roll under objects.
[*] Player now stays crouched when firing the bow. 
[*] Skill level curves have been adjusted.
[*] Loot vacuuming now only vacuums items of the same type.
[*] Player can now paint pillows and curtains.
[*] All buildables now maintain support when reloading a world. 
[*] Facilities have updated icons in the build menu. 
[*] Insufficient tool message will now appear when using incorrect tool.
[*] The game no longer autosaves when exiting and instead allows player to choose. This prevents player who are checking the state of a save by loading it from overwriting their saves. 
[*] Share code can now be copied to the clipboard by clicking it.
[*] Empty hotbar slots can now be selected.
[*] Currently selected hotbar slot is identified with filigree below the slot.
[*] Button prompts for controller hotbar controls have been added. 
[*] Artisan bench now includes messaging when the player has nothing to customize.
[*] Corrupted saves are now recognized to let players know to load a backup.
[*] Added a versioning system.
[*] Audio cue has been added for when equipment breaks.
[*] Drowning sounds have been added. 
[*] Several misc. Audio, Performance, and UI improvements.
[/list]
[h2]BUG FIXES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Certain saves with extremely large numbers of buildables should be able to be loaded properly. 
[*] Characters now save properly if Steam name consists only of periods. 
[*] Items no longer fall through buildables when dropped from a chest.
[*] Grass removed by buildables no longer reappears at further distances.
[*] Buildable target outline now appears before selecting a buildable. 
[*] Player can now reset the color of a buildable to its default state with the paint brush.
[*] Portals now unlock correctly when portal projects are completed. 
[*] Frost and poison arrows now count towards kill quests when used to kill enemies. 
[*] Gorgon teleporting behavior has been significantly improved.
[*] Player can no longer prevent drowning damage by jumping. 
[*] Player can no longer gain glide XP while slow falling.
[*] Warmed Up buff can now be refreshed.
[*] Tin pickaxe and axe now require tin ingots instead of copper ingots. 
[*] Gold pickaxe now requires hard resin. 
[*] Ambrosia ingot sell price has been increased to 7 gold. 
[*] Refineries with fire no longer extinguish from rain when covered by structures.
[*] Smelter output will now display the correct ingots
[*] Player no longer hovers over ground after glide dashing repeatedly. 
[*] Player is no longer launched into the sky when swimming between ocean and river. 
[*] Player can now maintain sprint when sprinting and dodging. 
[*] Player now loses stealth temporarily when dodging.
[*] Axe and Pick are no longer canceled mid swing when moving.
[*] Heavy sword attack will now enter block if block is held before attack is finished. 
[*] Camera now smoothly transitions from crouched to standing.
[*] Camera position while gliding and ADS is now aligned with reticle. 
[*] Downward chop animation no longer plays when chopping upright trees. 
[*] Crafting a consumable while consuming one will no longer cancel the action.
[*] Consumables no longer get stuck in characters hand when attempting to consume while consuming. 
[*] Turning off Unlock All Abilities world setting now returns the player to their natural abilities unlocked state based on their progression. 
[*] Copper, Iron and Gold Nodes now properly display chunk damage when mining. 
[*] Hunting lures are no longer removed when relogging. 
[*] Trees can no longer be severed entirely without being felled.
[*] Felled trees no longer disappear when other trees fall on them. 
[*] Animal star rating now updates as soon as it changes from being hit. 
[*] Animal star ratings now displays correctly when rejoining a server. 
[*] Replacing items on hotbar after using arrow wheel no longer causes items to be dropped.
[*] Items are no longer dropped when an item is placed over another in Aeacus sell slots.
[*] Player can now quick transfer items to Aeacus sell slots.
[*] Armor can now be transferred from armor slots into a chest.
[*] D-pad will now update quest info when a new quest list entry is highlighted. 
[*] Directional navigation can now move between hotbar and recipes.
[*] Items are now removed from cursor when opening the map from the inventory screen. 
[*] Repair Kit interaction is now cancelled when moving to other screens. 
[*] Durability is now correctly displayed when first repairing an item.
[*] Broken armor that is repaired can now continue to take damage.
[*] Armor no longer selects a single piece to take damage.
[*] Taking damage from swimming no longer degrades armor durability.
[*] Consumables now display correct icon in food / potion slots. 
[*] Cloak versions of armor now have correct UI icons.
[*] Refineries now message when the player has no relevant items in their inventory. 
[*] Messaging for lighting all braziers within a biome has been improved. 
[*] Hunter quest now says “Hare” instead of “Hares” to match quest requirement.
[*] Receiving messages while chat box is open no longer hides all previous messages. 
[*] Brazier of Apollo text no longer displays a debug string. 
[*] Refinery no longer plays working sfx when while idle. 
[*] Aeacus will no longer repeat lines when relogging.
[*] Players can no longer hear others drinking potions. 
[*] Clients can now hear the temple door opening. [/list]

Please join us in [url=https://discord.gg/dV6s7CHHZj]Discord[/url] for game discussions, challenges, and assistance! Let us know your thoughts on these changes, and continue sharing your feedback with us through [url=https://dawnofdefiance.featureupvote.com/]feature up-vote[/url]. We look forward to getting you another update next month.

[h2]Discord Reminder[/h2]
For our Discord members, please make sure you accept the Defiers role in the #welcomes-and-rules channel, and then toggle which notifications you would like in the #reaction-roles channel, so you are always notified of patches, updates, and additional news as preferred, like livestreams, challenges, and daily quests.

Until October!

Cheers, Defiers!
- Traega Team

notes.title: Creative & Build Patch - 8/28/2024
notes.content:
[i][b]PATCH NOTE CORRECTION (8/29/2024): Original notes excluded two other changes, including: 1. Ambrosia Crystal quest has been removed. 2. Grindstone Refinery is now unlocked later in progression. [/b][/i]

Today we're super excited to share with you another patch that should offer various quality of life updates, including the much requested creative world settings like the ability to disable building costs and to unlock all recipes, alongside some new items to populate your amazing builds, such as daybeds, pillows, new railings, walls, and more. Please enjoy this more elaborate introduction to the patch from our team, followed by an impressive build tour:

[previewyoutube=3KBHpdwQmNQ;full][/previewyoutube]
For the build challenge referenced at the end of the video, please join the [url=https://discord.gg/dV6s7CHHZj] Discord [/url] for more info, or read through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2059530/announcements/detail/4284698870310020871?snr=2___] community hub page[/url]. Now, here we'll break down the patch notes for you:

[h2]Feature Additions: [/h2][list]
[*] The following world settings have been added to rulesets:
[list][*] Disable Durability
[*] Disable Crafting Costs
[*] Disable Building Costs (Experimental Players may experience some issues with large numbers of buildables)
[*] Unlock All Recipes
[*] Grant All Movement Abilities [/list]
[*] Tool progression for mining and wood cutting has been changed.
[*] Players can now interact with chests to quickly add items which already exist within the chest.
[*] Several Buildables have been added to the game 
[list][*] Decor - Daybed, Pillows, Taxidermy Boar, Taxidermy Wolf, Taxidermy Hare, Taxidermy Wabbit, Curtains, Throne
[*] Thatch Kit - Stair Railing, Railings, Post, Thatch Door
[*] Wood Kit - Wall Section, Half Arch Large, Archway, Column Sections, Wall Filler Angle Inverted, Wall Filler Archway, Stair Railing
[*] Stone Kit - Wall Section, Half Arch Large, Column, Wall Filler Angle Inverted, Wall Filler Archway, Post [/list]
[/list]
[h2]Improvements:[/h2][list]
[*] Adjusted camera sensitivity to reduce jitter at low mouse speeds.
[*] Hitting a resource node with an insufficient tool will now message the required tool. 
[*] Arrow counts now always show on bows equipped to the hotbar.
[*] Hunter quest now only requires killing one hare instead of three.
[*] Builder I quest objectives have been changed to crafting a simple hammer and building a lumbermill.
[*] Cave quest now requires Ambrosia dust instead of ambrosia crystals.
[*] Island of Arrival portal now requires less ambrosia dust to build.
[*] Some 2 and 3-Star fauna now give more resources.
[*] Woodsmen Potion crafting requirements reduced and now adds more chop damage.
[*] Armor Coating Potion ingredients now requires Spartium instead of Resin.
[*] Birdfeeder recipe now cost less from Aeacus.
[*] Simple Pick now sells for more to Aeacus.
[*] Large and medium tree stumps now give more Resin.
[*] Wood fences now have posts on both sides.
[*] Stone roof mesh no longer has minor culling. 
[*] Simple hammer mesh has been updated.
[*] Add I-Frames to dodge roll.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes: [/h2][list]
[*] Chests and Lion statues no longer break on relog.
[*] 1-Star Bucks now give two pelts instead of none. 
[*] Builder quest II and IV now give credit to builds only once the quest is accepted.
[*] Aeacus tabs can now be navigated with Q/E.
[*] Aeacus Purchase and Contribute/Accept/Complete Quest button has been stylized to be more visible.
[*] Taking all items from gravestones now adds to existing stacks in the players inventory properly. 
[*] Taking all items from gravestones while player inventory is full no longer spills items onto the ground.
[*] World settings are no longer being copied between worlds. 
[*] Official ruleset names can no longer be overwritten.
[*] Discovered POI’s are shared among all players.
[*] Loot Queue no longer fires when placing items back down in Aeacus sell tab.
[*] An issue with UI prompts for refineries constructed by clients has been fixed.
[*] Player swimming height synchronization with water has been improved.
[*] Pressing sprint button while strafing no longer causes the player to stutter.
[*] Punching no longer stops working when switching items while drinking potions.
[*] Client bow attack has had its animation improved. 
[*] Hunter quest now only counts hares after receiving the quest.
[*] Fixed an issue with a desync state clients could end up in, resulting in not being able to shoot the bow or glide.
[*] Golem will now turn to throw boulders at the player.
[*] Golem can no longer be moved with Hardfall. [/list]

Thanks again for all your support! We'll let you know when another patch or update is coming your way as we continue to focus on quality-of-life improvements. In the meantime, please continue to send us feedback on [url=https://dawnofdefiance.featureupvote.com/] Feature Up-vote [/url] and hang out with our community in [url=https://discord.gg/dV6s7CHHZj] Discord[/url]. 

Signed,
The Traega Team

notes.title: Quality of LIfe Patch - 08/22/2024
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone playing Dawn of Defiance! Following our launch last Thursday, we've been keeping tabs on your bugs and suggestions and working to implement the best changes for you. Before we get into the specifics, here's a couple notifications we'd like you to read:

[h3][b]PSA FOR INTEL USERS:[/b] [/h3]

There is an issue with Intel 13th and 14th Gen CPUs (13700, 13900, 14700, 14900 series) that we want to make sure everyone is aware of.  We STRONGLY suggest you check out this post and apply the BIOS update as Intel has confirmed they have an issue with your specific CPU that can cause permanent damage. This can cause problems while using a range of software - not just Dawn of Defiance - so it's worth the time it would take to apply the patch to your BIOS:

[url=https://community.intel.com/t5/Processors/Microcode-0x129-Update-for-Intel-Core-13th-and-14th-Gen-Desktop/m-p/1622129] Intel Community - Update for Intel Core 13th & 14th Gen [/url]

Here are additional links with further information on the issue:

[url=https://www.radgametools.com/oodleintel.htm] Processor Instability Decompression Failures [/url]
[url=https://www.tomshardware.com/pc-components/cpus/intel-cpu-instability-crashing-bug-includes-65w-and-higher-skus-intel-says-damage-is-irreversible-no-planned-recall] CPU Crashing and Instability [/url]
[url=https://www.pcgamer.com/hardware/processors/intel-cpu-crashes-what-you-need-to-knowmicrocode-to-blame-but-fix-incoming-this-month-alongside-two-year-extended-warranty/] CPU Crashes - What you need to know [/url]

[h3][b]ANOTHER UPDATE COMING NEXT WEEK:[/b] [/h3]

Please anticipate an update next week which will include a creative mode and additional buildables and decor which will expand your potential for amazing builds. We'll also give you a little behind the scenes look at other content updates down the pipeline. 

Thank you again!

---

[h1]QoL PATCH NOTES (1/?) [/h1]

[h3][b]Feature Additions: [/b]
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Auto Stack button has been added to personal inventory to consolidate stacks.
[/list]
[h3][b]Improvements: [/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Adding materials to refineries has been sped up. We intend to make this even faster in a future patch. 
[*] Made optimization changes to reduce fauna jitter issues
[*] Stamina costs have been reduced on many non-combat related actions:

[list]
[*] Tools usage consumes 33% less stamina
[*] Sprint consumes 50% less stamina
[*] Dash consumes 40% less stamina
[*] Glide consumes 33% less stamina
[/list]
[*] Glide Speed increased 15%.
[*] Hares spawns are now more prevalent on the Isle of Arrival.
[*] Hares have been scaled up to be more visible.
[*] Item stack maximums have been increased for most items.
[*] Merchant sell values for primitive and simple equipment updated.
[*] Merchant sell values for forged equipment have been adjusted to reflect their primary crafting materials.
[*] Animation speeds on consumables have been adjusted to be more consistent between eating and drinking.
[*] Aeacus’s generic welcome lines now occur less frequently.
[*] Inventory controls are now shown as the default bottom right panel instead of player stats.
[*] Voyager Armor set icons are updated to show more accurate representations of the armor visuals and cloak options.
[*] Athena Shrine quest text messaging has been improved for Wayward Soldier locations.
[*] Wayward Soldier camps now appear on map and compass.
[*] Temple map icon has been replaced with a Portal map icon to ensure the portal within is easier to find.
[*] Correct statues are now at place of power locations.
[*] Portal inside of Temple of Hecate now has banner light posts and is pulled away from the wall for better visibility.
[*] Rain VFX have received a performance pass under light, regular and heavy thunderstorm conditions.
[/list]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] [/h3]

[list]
[*] Controller now rotates buildables in 15 degree increments and is slowed down on decorations. 
[*] Saves now save properly when having to trust client-sent ID.
[*] Quest stat counter for Shrines Defiled is now properly tracked fixing quest completion. 
[*] Mirrored Lion Statue now has collision and can be deconstructed
[*] Soldiers no longer freeze when they reach their maximum leash range
[*] Look for additional soldier AI updates in the near future
[*] Place of Power III location no longer can be discovered from the caves below it
[*] All forged spears now have Steel and Ambrosia crafting options.
[*] Gamepad Layout menu now displays correct controls.
[*] Ambrosia Crystal base no longer errantly display forged tool required message.
[*] Armor Cloak versions now show cloaks in their icons.
[*] Consumables icons now display proper icons on HUD.
[*] Ping can no longer get stuck on the edge of compass. 
[*] Fixed Aeacus' dialogue and late game enemies appearing too soon.
[*] Campfire light now respects active vs inactive state.
[*] Grindstone mesh now has its base and all internal components.
[*] Voyager Soldier Cuirass with and without cloak now shows the correct material for silver.
[*] Gorgon VFX package now has improved performance and visuals. Handling of activation and deactivations of these VFX have been improved.
[*] Enemy spawn VFX no longer spawns too many times and now have improved performance under all scalability options with improved visuals.
[*] Captain Warcry VFX has been added.
[*] Campfires found at camps and caves should no longer turn bright white.
[/list]

Thank you so much for playing! We hope you're having fun and that these changes improve your...quality of life. Yes. Thank you!

<3 The Traega Team

notes.title: Our 10 Day Countdown Begins!
notes.content:
Today officially begins our 10 day countdown until early access! Are you ready to join us on the Crossroads, Defiers?

As we’ve mentioned on the store and in our FAQ pages, we wanted to give you a better idea of our priorities for early access before our launch next week! To respect the possibility that our internal priorities may need to be adjusted after we’ve weighed community feedback after launch, we want to keep this initial “pre” roadmap high-level, so there’s flexibility to modify without false promises at this stage. To add more detail to the attached graphic, here is the simple outline:

[h3]Immediate Goals:[/h3]
[b]Quality of Life Improvements –[/b] Please expect our first 2-3 months after launch to be focused on improving the immediate needs of players to make the game the best it can be for long-term growth!
[b]Roadmap Assessments – [/b]We will compare the feedback/suggestions/requests from players at launch with our internal planned feature list and the time we will be able to sustain early access to then dictate our priorities. 
[b]Improved Shrine Labors –[/b] Part of your trials on the Crossroads is to visit the shrines of the Olympians and complete their associated Labors. We aim to upgrade this existing experience with more thoughtful and challenging quests before adding the remaining shrines.

[h3]Short Term Goals: [/h3]
[b]Expand the Crossroads and advance the narrative –[/b] You’ll notice when you join our game on the 15th that part of our map is locked! We will be working to open this up to players which will include unlocking the remaining 4 Olympian shrines. With all 12 shrines on the map to complete, we will be able to progress the player on to the final arc of our narrative.
[b]More buildables –[/b] We have a backlog of art assets nearly finished, namely buildables, that we can see being wrapped up in the short-term to expand players' options!

[h3]On the Table:[/h3]
[b]Character Creator (ultimately to include a female protagonist), more mythical enemies, and mod support– [/b]These are things the Dev team would like to see in our 1.0. Where they fall in our priority list remains to be decided!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/ba9f5e8c92049a5741e18ee64dae7ad579ed955c.jpg[/img]
Hopefully this information helps understand how our team will be approaching early access, and we look forward to working with the community to finalize a more comprehensive roadmap post-launch. Given part of this plan involves you and your feedback, you’re probably wondering how you will communicate with us!

At launch, we will unlock our feature up-vote board as the official method to measure player interest/need in specific changes/suggestions. We’ll promote the link at that time. In addition, if players would like a more informal discussion about game suggestions and features, we will have Discord channels available.

Now allow me to toss in some extra visuals for you to start off the week, the last couple are a cool player build we got to see thanks to friends and family who joined us in our recent playtest! We got some great feedback and loved seeing new players trying Dawn of Defiance for the first time. Check these out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/ad9fbb7ec56fee83b943409e0d0ec4b02ac1faa2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/cd4bee3b92145181a81b134c7c8942c4651fe8c9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/2f65300377d04e31c48bb8511ea63d57f1b62314.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/7d41c206cdba61f902ef76232028651b2a7bc252.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/057b61d29c5aec8ae2a0fe91e17e2117e889babe.jpg[/img]
And to round out today’s update, the FAQ page should now have more details on server settings for those of you who have been waiting for that information, and lastly, we will be throwing down ideas for the community launch week activities in Discord this week, including themed build challenges, so if you enjoy that sort of thing, definitely swing on in and join the conversation! We hope you participate with us on August 15th!

JOIN[url=https://discord.gg/dV6s7CHHZj] THE DEFIANCE DISCORD[/url]

Thanks everyone for tuning in for these announcements. Remember to share our game with your friends, and we'll see you next week ;)

- Traega Monday

With all 12 shrines on the map to complete, we will be able to progress the player on to the final arc of our narrative.
More buildables – We have a backlog of art assets nearly finished, namely buildables, that we can see being wrapped up in the short-term to expand players' options!

Character Creator (ultimately to include a female protagonist), more mythical enemies, and mod support– These are things the Dev team would like to see in our 1.0. Where they fall in our priority list remains to be decided!

At launch, we will unlock our feature up-vote board as the official method to measure player interest/need in specific changes/suggestions. We’ll promote the link at that time. In addition, if players would like a more informal discussion about game suggestions and features, we will have Discord channels available.

notes.title: What's New in July?
notes.content:
Yesterday, our newsletter and Discord members received the latest of our development updates which means it's time to share with you all! We’re one month away from our early access launch, so we’ve locked in content and now we’re focusing on optimization, testing, and polish. To tide you over until our final, pre-launch August update, here’s a few highlights of recent additions to Dawn of Defiance and some general community notes.

[h2]DEV UPDATES[/h2]

[h3]Map Changes[/h3]

[u][b]The Golden Path(s)[/b][/u]
We know many gamers are terrible at making decisions and awful at directions (something something we never leave the house kekw), so paths have been carved into the landscape in select locations to assist those who find themselves forever stuck in the same mountain range for hours at a time. Whether you trailblaze or follow the paths, they lend character to the world and features to incorporate in your player builds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/f9543b5974887e83e6a50ba0e0feb483c327b5bc.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Cave Systems[/b][/u]
Personally, the main thing I look for in an open world game is the ability to roleplay as Smeagol, so great news, everyone! In our last full dev update, we told you caves were up next in the development pipeline, and we’re happy to confirm they’ve made good progress and will offer you new areas to explore in the Crossroads at launch and grounds for cave-dweller theatrics if you’re so inclined. As briefly shown in our first compendium entry, Ambrosia will be found in caves alongside enemies. And for those curious, yes! You can build underground!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/ffd1ab21010cade678c290f1de45afea5dbb2c6c.jpg[/img]
[h3]Audio Pass[/h3]

[u][b]Cave Depths[/b][/u]
Nothing curtails my incredible Smeagol RP more than being in an cave with no sound effects. That really inhibits my immersion. I would know; I’ve been in the situation frequently. But if you’re anything like me (a translucent little freak), you’ll be happy to know our cave overhaul included a new and improved audio soundscape! Take a sneak auditory peak at a moment underground. Watch your heads, please.

[previewyoutube=LpKknRiRbUQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]Mediterranean Music[/b][/u]
So you’ve heard about sound effects, but what about music? As we’ve shared before, there are multiple biomes across the islands, and to give them each a unique flavor, so to speak— please, don’t lick the sand, gamers—we’ve collaborated with a composer to create different music mixes, such as the one below. Yeah, it’s getting kind of cinematic in here. I’m lore-walking everywhere. What do you think?

[previewyoutube=urG2HQo46BY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Game Art[/h3]

[u][b]New Facilities[/b][/u]
What is a hero without good equipment? Dead, probably. Defiers will need to continue to expand their base with player facilities from spits to smelters. Creating and revising these crafting workbenches has been an important ongoing part of development, so we’re excited to see some of the final art for the stations come in, including the butchery table and hunters bench which allow you to scrap animal parts and convert pelts into gear, respectively. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/7fa97f318f90480162e1dcc3e2f00484d2627a38.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Your Just Guide[/u][/b]
You didn’t arrive in the Crossroads by chance. There’s a presence waiting for you across the water. He’ll need your assistance—and you’ll need his. With his guidance, Defiers will improve their skills and seek out shrines across the map. This mysterious figure is currently undergoing another art pass before we’ll introduce him in the launch trailer next month. For now, enjoy his brooding silhouette. I’m sure his front side is significantly less broody and intimidating, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/2f915892bf72ca2dd45cf1892260f9a47c70b5ee.jpg[/img]
[h3]Player Progression‍[/h3]

[u][b]Fast Travel[/b][/u]
These islands aren’t small, and even with your glide ability, it would take awhile to cross from one side to another. A god would never walk, so why should you? By proving yourself on the Isle of Arrival, you open up the pathways between portals, allowing you to step through to different regions of the unlocked map. Needless to say, they’ve made the world feel much more accessible and long trial treks more convenient!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/30681aab9bdb03f3f907cccff58d6fba854b025a.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Deity Trials[/b][/u]
On that note, our designers have made massive headway implementing the deity shrines of the Crossroads and their corresponding trials. At early access launch, you’ll be able to visit 8 of the final, planned 12 to complete the challenge, defile the altar, and earn rewards inspired by the Gods. Not only do the trials empower you, but they advance your cause on the isles, bringing you ever closer to ridding the Gods' presence from the Crossroads.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/bb5b3983bef77354f19acdc245c66f0a4ed681ca.jpg[/img]
[h3]Enemies‍[/h3]

[u][b]Bad Guy Polish[/b][/u]
We’ve been making small tweaks to existing enemies to make combat more seamless and enjoyable, such as wolves flinching and improved aim stance for Lost Archers. Perhaps the biggest improvements I’ve personally noted have been made to the Soldiers, previously unseen in our last two trailers due to an armor glitch! But they’ve finally put their clothes on— thank the Gods— and you’ll encounter them around most ruins, defending the ancient powers. Prepare to be confronted if you come too close!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/421e28186a1f2301194989aba06dff2bb29a91d5.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Wisps!![/b][/u]
These funny little guys can now be found on the map. They seem to have beaten you to all the objectives and flitter over places of power, shrines, and braziers. You can smack them around, you can follow them. They drop dust. But most importantly, they make little jingly noises. They actually have more functionality than that, but we’ll wait to tell you a bit more about them another time (compendium, anyone?)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012627/dcd23685e1660a2d934986e85db74e31de45a3b5.jpg[/img]

[h2]COMMUNITY NOTES[/h2]

[h3]Up Next:[/h3] [b]Final Art, Optimization, & Polish[/b]

We’re now in that pre-launch window where we need to test the game extensively, so you don’t somehow trek where none have yet trekked and find yourself recreating the Icarus myth against your will, as you’re hurled inexplicably into the stratosphere. We’re working with additional outsourced QA while continuing to swap out final art assets and refine animations, progression, and economy for the gameplay loop available at early access launch, but no new overhauls to mechanics, quests, or direction at this time before early access.‍

[h3]Minor News & Corrections[/h3]

[b]Achievements on Hold[/b]
Our last community monthly mentioned polling some in-game achievements, but based on current priorities, we’re decided to hold back on implementing achievements until after our early access launch, so we can focus on refining and testing the gameplay loop.

[b]The 12 Trials[/b]
In the last month, we’ve decided to block off a part of the Crossroads to allow us more flexible map-space to add more content during early access (without physically affecting the landscape players will be actively using by that time). This adjustment would lock 4 of the 12 trials out of players' reach at launch. Because of this, I’ll be adding a note to the FAQ that 8 trials will be immediately playable, with the intention to expand in early access.

[b]Launch Trailer Coming Soon![/b]
You’ll get at least one more gameplay preview before our launch next month. We’ll be starting that asset this week! Stay tuned and share our socials with your friends!‍

[h3]Community Build:[/h3] [b]Fawn Coliseum[/b]

Last but not least, the June community monthly invited Defiers into the Discord to help me poll two creative builds. The second of the two builds will be attached to the brief July Community Monthly next week, but for the first poll, you all selected the “Bunny Coliseum.” At long last, I have edited together that process to hopefully expound on the potentials of our build kits, though you’ll have to forgive the lack of bunnies. I didn’t realize it was fawn season. Enjoy the full edit here or in the Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/dV6s7CHHZj]The Defiance Discord[/url]

[previewyoutube=3L-w7ObcJUc;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for supporting Dawn of Defiance! More updates coming your way before August 15th, but until then keeping getting hype for early access next month!

- Traega Monday

notes.title: Revealing Our Launch Date!
notes.content:
We were thrilled to announce during IGN Live today that Dawn of Defiance, our open-world, survival-crafting game inspired by ancient Greek mythology, launches into early access Aug. 15, 2024, on Steam and the Epic Games Store. 

[previewyoutube=VQ7D17150ls;full][/previewyoutube]

This news coincided with all-new gameplay footage highlighting game features only briefly touched on in our reveal. This trailer expands on our expansive build systems, showing off decorative props and architectural pieces you can use to create a wide range of classical Greek structures, from grand halls to towering temples. Likewise, we revealed a new late-game enemy type: the Gorgons! You'll want to prepare your best gear and potions to take on these dangerous monsters lurking on the isles.

Community members were teased some of the updates shown in the trailer, such as the new biomes, items, and caves, so if you want to get development updates on Dawn Of Defiance before anyone else, make sure to follow us on socials, join us in Discord, and subscribe to the newsletter.

[url=www.dawnofdefiance.com]Visit the official Dawn Of Defiance website.[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/dV6s7CHHZj]Join the Defiance in Discord.[/url] 

We're super excited to see players take to the isles and start their journey on the Forgotten Crossroads this Summer. Please bring us your hard-hitting questions and stay tuned for more news before our launch in August. 

- Traega Team
